card.name: Words just before a named interacting drug
card.fires_on: Linking words or punctuation (with, and, or, a comma, a colon, taking, of) right before a second drug name in drug-interaction text. Also the end of a drug class name such as Antihelmintics.

modes.label: Link before co-given drug
modes.description: A small linking word sits between one drug and another drug it is given with.
